sql: SELECT s.AvgScrMath, sch.County FROM satscores s JOIN schools sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode WHERE s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL AND (s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrWrite) = (SELECT MIN(AvgScrMath + AvgScrRead + AvgScrWrite) FROM satscores WHERE AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL)
